items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1962-01-03
items.q: And this girl Alma was playing piano.

ctx.x: I started to play some of the little schoolroom house like this. Just like this house, straight up. Started dancing there, playing there. I had a time, they couldn't pay me. Me and my trumpet player lost. We take the drop. And all the jewels. Could buy, drink, and pay them. I know my tribe was playing drum with us, at the bass. And this girl Alma was playing piano.
